issues: The page being swallowed was generic 18–26px type, unreadable at 1080p and placeholder-like
Block sizes were arbitrary pixel values with nothing to snap to, so the jumps could read as dropped frames
The blue takeover held only a 170px smiley badge and the red pass ended on one small card: neither half landed on a poster frame
A and B were two hard-cut scenes, saturated blue against saturated red, with no story linking them
changes: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt), with the B block in the look's navy ink: neutrals plus one accent instead of a blue-red clash
Every jump snaps to a visible 12x9 grid of 160x120 cells marked by crosshair ticks; A's in-between states are pixel-rounded crosses (a union of two rects), five jumps at uneven 7/9/8/10f intervals
The document is rebuilt with publication-grade native layout: 120px title, 40px body, a 36px checklist and an AI prompt row that motivates the cobalt takeover

The two passes now hand off as one story: after the cobalt takeover the badge pops in three hard steps under a 120px 'Drafted in 4 seconds.', then a navy triangle eats the cobalt field in three jumps and carries the release card into its final slot
Everything outside the step grammar is smooth for contrast (slow page push, headlines rising word by word); the closing period is a cobalt pixel that appears in a hard step
Duration 150 to 180f, ending on a 34f hold of 'Ready to ship.' plus the release card as a complete poster
